```{r libraries}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(bnlearn)
library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
library(sf)
```

### Create Conditional Probability Tables (CPT)

```{r CPTs}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

urban_prox_cpt<-matrix(c(0.3333333, 0.3333333,0.3333333), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))
road_density_cpt<-matrix(c(0.3333333, 0.3333333,0.3333333), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))

disturb_index_cpt<-c(rep(0.3333333,27))#3^3

dim(disturb_index_cpt) = c(3, 3, 3)

dimnames(disturb_index_cpt) = list("disturb_index" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"), "urban_prox" =  c("LOW","MED", "HIGH"),"road_density" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"))

patch_size_cpt<-matrix(c(0.3333333, 0.3333333,0.3333333), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))

total_edge_cpt<-matrix(c(0.3333333, 0.3333333,0.3333333), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))

woodland_cpt<-matrix(c(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25), ncol=4, dimnames = list(NULL, c( "BROADLEAVED","CONIFER", "MIXED_PREDOM_BROADLEAF","MIXED_PREDOM_CONIFER")))


nutritional_index_cpt<-c(rep(0.333333,108)) 

dim(nutritional_index_cpt) = c(3, 3, 3,4)

dimnames(nutritional_index_cpt) = list("nutritional" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"), "patch_size" =  c("LOW","MED", "HIGH"),"total_edge" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"),
                                       "woodland" = c("BROADLEAVED","CONIFER", "MIXED_PREDOM_BROADLEAF","MIXED_PREDOM_CONIFER"))


linear_feature_cpt<-matrix(c(0.3333333, 0.3333333,0.3333333), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))
shelter_cpt<-matrix(c(0.3333333, 0.3333333,0.3333333), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))


deer_damage_cpt<-c(rep(0.333333,243))#3^5

dim(deer_damage_cpt) = c(3, 3, 3,3,3)

dimnames(deer_damage_cpt) = list("deer_damage" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"), "disturb_index" =  c("LOW","MED", "HIGH"),"linear_feature" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"), "nutritional"=c("LOW","MED","HIGH"), "shelter"=c("LOW","MED", "HIGH"))

```

### Create BN Structure

```{r BN structure}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

net<-model2network("[urban_prox][road_density][linear_feature][woodland][patch_size][total_edge][shelter][disturb_index|urban_prox:road_density][nutritional|woodland:patch_size:total_edge][deer_damage|disturb_index:linear_feature:shelter:nutritional]") # You dont need to repeat the names of the nodes with parents (child nodes) 

# Custom fitting network (matching up the nodes to their CPTs)
dfit = custom.fit(net, dist = list(urban_prox = urban_prox_cpt, road_density = road_density_cpt,linear_feature = linear_feature_cpt, woodland=woodland_cpt,
                                   patch_size=patch_size_cpt, total_edge=total_edge_cpt, shelter=shelter_cpt, disturb_index=disturb_index_cpt,nutritional= nutritional_index_cpt,deer_damage= deer_damage_cpt))


```

### Look at the BN

#### Ugly plot

```{r plot the network}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

graphviz.plot(net)

```

#### Parameters

```{r look at the dfit}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
dfit

```

### Set evidence

```{r set evidence}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
cpquery(dfit, c(total_edge == "LOW"|shelter == "LOW"|woodland=="BROADLEAVED"), (deer_damage=="HIGH"))

```

#### Test with the dummy data

```{r spatial data}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# need to do some cleaning of dummy data
dummy_BBN_spatial_data <- readRDS("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer_Local/BBN_structure/inputs/dummy_BBN_spatial_data.RDS")
#convert to upper
dummy_BBN_spatial_data<-dummy_BBN_spatial_data |> 
 mutate(across(where(is.character), toupper))

dummy_BBN_spatial_data<-dummy_BBN_spatial_data |> 
  mutate(across(patch_size:damage, ~gsub("MEDIUM","MED",.)))
test_data<-dummy_BBN_spatial_data |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::select(patch_size:woodland)

test_data<-test_data |> 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

levels(test_data$patch_size)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$road_density)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$nutritional)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$urban_prox)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$total_edge)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$linear_feature)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$shelter)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")


```

#### Predict from the BN using the dummy data

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

test_data<-test_data
pred = predict(dfit, node = "disturb_index", data = test_data,method = "bayes-lw")

dummy_BBN_spatial_data$pred<-pred

```

#### Draw a nice map

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

plot(dummy_BBN_spatial_data["pred"])

```
